title: K. Karasaev atyndagy BMUda Sergey Aleksandrovich Novopashindin “Sogushtardyn typologysy: sogushtan tartyp discoursedikke chein”

blocks.text: 2025-zhyldyn 13th May Kusein Karasaev atyndagy Bishkek mamlekettik universityinde Rossiyalyk philosopher, sayasat taanuuchu zhana publicist Sergey Alexandrovich Novopashindyn “Sogushtardyn typologysy: sogushtan tartyp discoursedikke cheyin” degen topic lecturesy bolup өttu. Ish-chara Uluu Ata Mekendik sogushtagy Zhenishtin 80 zhyldygyna arnalgan ish-charalardyn alkagynda yushturuldu.

Sergey Novopashin - Zharandyk koomdu onunukturuu fondunun Ural federaldyk okrugundagy okulu, Yeltsin atyndagy Ural federaldyk universityinin Expert-analystik borborunun experts, Russian "Knowledge" koomunun lecturer, Rossiyalyk philosophialyk koomdun zhana Rossiyalyk geographylyk koomdun muchosu.

Bul lecture universitytin akademiyalyk zhana koomduk turmushundagy maaniluu okuya bolup, katyshuuchularga zhanzhaldardyn munozun zhana kelechekti kalyptandyruudagy oh zhugurtuunun ordun zhanycha baalogo mүmkүnchulүk berdi.

Sergey Novopashin's lecture was held at BSU named after K. Karasaev
on the typology of wars: from hot to discursive

On May 13, 2025, a lecture by the Russian philosopher, political scientist and publicist was held at the BSU named after K. Karasaev Sergei Alexandrovich Novopashin on the topic "Typology of Wars: From Hot to Discursive"The event was held as part of a series dedicated to the 80th anniversary of Victory in the Great Patriotic War of 1941–1945.

Sergey Novopashin is a representative of the Civil Society Development Fund in the Ural Federal District, an expert of the UrFU Expert and Analytical Center, a speaker of the Russian Knowledge Society, a member of the Russian Philosophical Society and the Russian Geographical Society.

The lecture became a significant event in the academic and social life of the university, giving participants the opportunity to take a new look at the nature of conflicts and the role of thinking in shaping the future.
© Meerim Tologonova - Head of the Department of Science, Postgraduate and Doctoral Studies
